Pig Latin Translator

Translate English to Pig Latin and back, with proper vowel, consonant-cluster and 'qu' rules plus case handling.

Vowel start → +way · consonant cluster → move +ay · qu moves together · case & punctuation kept.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste English text.
  2. Choose English → Pig Latin or Pig Latin → English.
  3. Press Convert.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What rules are used?

Words starting with a vowel get 'way' added (apple → appleway). Consonant clusters move to the end with 'ay' (string → ingstray). 'qu' moves together (queen → eenquay).

Does it keep capitalization and punctuation?

Yes — capitalization and punctuation are preserved, so 'Hello, world!' becomes 'Ellohay, orldway!'.

Is decoding perfect?

Decoding reverses the process but cannot always recover the original word, since multiple English words can map to the same Pig Latin form.
